evaluation_set: All 18 deduplicated pilot candidates after classifier corrections and contradiction-engine narrowing.

explicit.notes: All remain prior-art leads, not proof of open questions.

contradiction.notes: One ecological output overlaps another and is treated as a duplicate; all are apparent tensions only.

translation.notes: Structural equivalence remains unproven and is the object of the proposed tests.

data-use.notes: Materials Project is rejected for cyclic-fatigue adequacy; GEDI early-warning use is rejected without time-series linkage.

rejections.reason: Computed static materials properties do not by themselves measure accumulated cyclic fatigue.
Footprint biomass estimates alone do not establish repeated temporal recovery needed for early-warning analysis.

duplicates.reason: Both are generated from the same ecological recovery/resilience evidence pair and measurement-boundary issue.
